description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Changes to Sri Lanka Auditing Standards w.e.f. 01.01.2015 and Audit Report : As per SLAuS 700-2-14 with Changes - Independent Auditors' Report
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of revised auditing standards and quality control frameworks under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. It constitutes regulatory updates to professional standards that govern auditing practices, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or other specialized category.
